component_findings.application_testing: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-external--part-1--swift): Swift has mature, officially-endorsed (Apple/SSWG) or long-lived community libraries covering the classic backend/mobile domains: server-side web (Vapor), async networking core (SwiftNIO), HTTP client (Alamofire), database (GRDB), cryptography (swift-crypto), logging (swift-log), and CLI parsing (swift-argument-parser). Coverage is comparatively thin outside Apple-platform-oriented and server domains: Alamofire itself documents unsupported status on Linux/Windows/Android, and swift.org's own curated package categories are limited to a handful of areas (macros, server, networking, testing, logging, database) with no official category for data science/ML or general cross-platform desktop GUI.
